bug_semantics: Renovate's helmv3 manager appends the `repository` value read from a repository's Chart.yaml/Chart.lock (OCI registry host, attacker-controlled via repo write access) to the `helm registry login ... <repository>` shell command WITHOUT shlex-quoting it — while the username and password next to it ARE quoted. A crafted Chart.yaml repository field containing shell metacharacters (backticks, $(), ;, newline) breaks out of the command and executes arbitrary commands on the Renovate host (CWE-77 Command Injection).
flaw_origin: Commit f372a68144a4d78c9f7f418168e4efe03336a432 ("feat(helmv3): support for private repositories and registries in lock files (#13726)", 2022-01-24, author Sebastian Poxhofer <secustor@users.noreply.github.com>) introduced the login construction with the asymmetry intact: `parameters.push(`--username ${quote(username)}`); parameters.push(`--password ${quote(password)}`); cmd.push(`helm registry login ${parameters.join(' ')} ${value.repository}`)` — credentials quoted, the repository interpolated raw. Parent 3eea5034ba has no registry login at all (introducer_parent_absent semantics: the login command itself is born here). The 2023 refactor 2e8d2816f850 (#22510) carried the unquoted repository into generateLoginCmd (`... ${repositoryRule.repository}`), preserving the flaw verbatim.
